## Overview

Add native in-process LongSpark speculative decoding to Model Runner V2, with configurable draft lengths and reproducible serving benchmarks. See the [LongSpark paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37029) and [reference implementation](https://github.com/Hao-Yuan-He/LongSpark).

## Claims

- Register the `draftfreekv` checkpoint format, `DraftFreeKVModel`, and the `longspark` method; the target remains the sole owner of persistent K/V.
- Support `1 <= num_speculative_tokens <= checkpoint block_size`, defaulting to the full block. The checkpoint's trained block shape is preserved while only the requested proposal prefix is sampled and verified.
- Provide BF16 Global/Raw/Local/Markov kernels and use vLLM's CUDA Graph capture-size schedule for supported greedy drafting.
- Document [startup, `vllm bench serve` commands, and two LongSpark/DFlash performance tables](https://github.com/HaizhouPeng/vllm/blob/add-longspark/README.md#longspark), with the contract in the [feature guide](https://github.com/HaizhouPeng/vllm/blob/add-longspark/docs/features/speculative_decoding/longspark.md).

## Validation

### Serving benchmark results

Measured at one **RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell** Server Edition with **Qwen3-4B**, **BF16**, **7speculative tokens** for both methods, and fixed 256-token outputs. Each condition was run once; startup and warmup are excluded. Throughput is output tokens/s; draft throughput is proposed draft tokens divided by benchmark seconds. Acceptance length includes the bonus token.

#### Long-context datasets

Concurrency 4, 80 measured requests per condition.

| Dataset | Method | Output tok/s | TTFT (ms) | TPOT (ms/token) | Draft tok/s |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | 
| 28k | LongSpark | 99.44 | 2744.77 | 27.44 | 390.31 |
| 28k | DFlash | 76.41 | 2847.19 | 37.14 | 361.75 |

| 32k | DFlash | 63.51 | 3157.76 | 45.15 | 332.91 | 
| 40k | LongSpark | 90.19 | 4959.80 | 29.52 | 380.05 |
| 40k | DFlash | 46.98 | 5038.99 | 58.58 | 283.07 | 

#### MT-Bench

128 measured requests per condition.

| Concurrency | Method | Output tok/s | TTFT (ms) | TPOT (ms/token) | Draft tok/s |

| 1 | LongSpark | 301.54 | 35.83 | 3.18 | 782.72 | 
| 1 | DFlash | 248.21 | 35.18 | 3.91 | 779.62 | 
| 4 | LongSpark | 1036.78 | 35.24 | 3.51 | 2963.08 |
| 4 | DFlash | 860.18 | 35.87 | 4.13 | 2941.68 | 
| 8 | LongSpark | 1816.35 | 41.16 | 3.88 | 5197.18 |
| 8 | DFlash | 1507.87 | 44.99 | 4.60 | 5075.22 | 
| 16 | LongSpark | 2755.57 | 82.42 | 4.66 | 8233.38 | 
| 16 | DFlash | 2346.62 | 82.09 | 5.39 | 8142.83 |

+## LongSpark
+
+This branch supports native LongSpark speculative decoding with Qwen3 targets.
+Set `num_speculative_tokens` to any integer satisfying
+`1 <= num_speculative_tokens <= block_size`, where `block_size` is defined by
+the draft checkpoint. Omitting it uses the full checkpoint block. For a
+seven-token checkpoint, lengths 1 through 7 are supported without modifying
+the checkpoint configuration or weights. See the
+[LongSpark documentation](docs/features/speculative_decoding/longspark.md) for
+the supported model and runtime configurations.
+
+### Start a LongSpark server
+
+The following uses the local model paths and settings from the measurements
+below. Adjust paths to match your installation. The target and draft weights
+must already be downloaded.
+
+```bash
+source /home/ubuntu/workspace/.venv/bin/activate
+export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
+export NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost
+unset VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH
+
+vllm serve /home/ubuntu/workspace/models/Qwen3-4B \
+    --host 127.0.0.1 \
+    --port 18998 \
+    --dtype bfloat16 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
+    --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN \
+    --no-enable-prefix-caching \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
+    --max-model-len 45056 \
+    --max-num-seqs 16 \
+    --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
+    --hf-overrides '{"max_position_embeddings": 45056}' \
+    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128]}' \
+    --speculative-config '{
+      "method": "longspark",
+      "model": "/home/ubuntu/workspace/models/Qwen3-4B-LongSpark",
+      "num_speculative_tokens": 7
+    }'
+```
+
+To try a shorter draft, change only `num_speculative_tokens`, for example to 3.
+The draft backbone retains the trained block shape; the sampler and target
+verifier use only the requested number of proposals.
+
+For the DFlash comparison, stop the LongSpark server and run the same command
+with this speculative configuration:
+
+```json
+{
+  "method": "dflash",
+  "model": "/home/ubuntu/workspace/models/Qwen3-4B-DFlash",
+  "num_speculative_tokens": 7
+}
+```
+
+The 45056-position override accommodates the supplied 40k dataset, whose inputs
+plus output exceed the target's native 40960-position limit. No input was
+truncated, and weights and RoPE theta were unchanged. These measurements do not
+evaluate output quality beyond the native context limit.
+
+### Benchmark commands
+
+After the server is ready, run these commands in a second terminal. The local
+datasets must already exist. Run both loops once for each server, setting
+`BENCH_METHOD` to the active method so the result files remain separate.
+
+```bash
+source /home/ubuntu/workspace/.venv/bin/activate
+export NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost
+BENCH_MODEL=/home/ubuntu/workspace/models/Qwen3-4B
+BENCH_DATA=/home/ubuntu/workspace/data
+BENCH_METHOD=longspark  # Set to dflash after restarting the server with DFlash.
+BENCH_RESULTS=./benchmark-results/$BENCH_METHOD
+mkdir -p "$BENCH_RESULTS"
+
+# MT-Bench: 32 measured requests at each concurrency.
+for concurrency in 1 4 8 16; do
+    vllm bench serve \
+        --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18998 \
+        --model "$BENCH_MODEL" \
+        --tokenizer "$BENCH_MODEL" \
+        --dataset-name hf \
+        --dataset-path "$BENCH_DATA/philschmid/mt-bench" \
+        --hf-name philschmid/mt-bench \
+        --hf-output-len 256 \
+        --num-prompts 32 \
+        --max-concurrency "$concurrency" \
+        --temperature 0 --seed 42 --ignore-eos \
+        --num-warmups 1 --no-oversample --disable-tqdm \
+        --save-result --save-detailed \
+        --result-dir "$BENCH_RESULTS" \
+        --result-filename "mt-bench_c${concurrency}.json" \
+        --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el \
+        --metric-percentiles 50,90,95,99
+done
+
+# Long context: 10 measured requests per file, concurrency fixed at 4.
+for length in 28k 32k 40k; do
+    vllm bench serve \
+        --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18998 \
+        --model "$BENCH_MODEL" \
+        --tokenizer "$BENCH_MODEL" \
+        --dataset-name custom \
+        --dataset-path "$BENCH_DATA/longcontext_en_prompt_${length}.jsonl" \
+        --custom-output-len 256 \
+        --num-prompts 10 \
+        --max-concurrency 4 \
+        --temperature 0 --seed 42 --ignore-eos \
+        --num-warmups 1 --no-oversample --disable-tqdm \
+        --save-result --save-detailed \
+        --result-dir "$BENCH_RESULTS" \
+        --result-filename "longcontext_${length}_c4.json" \
+        --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el \
+        --metric-percentiles 50,90,95,99
+done
+```

+### Serving benchmark results
+
+Measured on 2026-10-27 at commit `3f569234d9c9c8b35f79e4d5aa61380edfd24d53`
+using one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (97887 MiB, driver
+580.178.04), Qwen3-4B, BF16 weights/KV, Model Runner V2, FlashAttention, and
+TP/PP/DCP/PCP = 1. Both methods used seven speculative tokens, prefix caching
+disabled, and the server settings above. These are measurements of the
+seven-token configuration, not new measurements of shorter draft lengths.
+
+All end-to-end measurements used `vllm bench serve`, temperature 0, seed 42,
+and exactly 256 output tokens per request. All 316 measured requests across
+14 conditions succeeded, with no KV-cache preemptions. Startup and one warmup

+# LongSpark
+
+[LongSpark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37029) is a parallel drafter for
+long-context speculative decoding. Its implementation and checkpoints are
+available from the [LongSpark project](https://github.com/Hao-Yuan-He/LongSpark).
+The published Qwen3 checkpoints condition each seven-token draft block on three
+bounded views:
+
+- Global16, an incrementally updated summary of the committed target prefix;
+- Raw256, the latest target K/V rows; and
+- Local7, the current draft block.
+
+The Model Runner V2 integration runs the target and drafter in one process and
+keeps the target as the sole owner of persistent K/V. The first prefill scans
+the committed prefix to initialize Global16. Later verification steps merge
+only newly committed target rows into that state.
+
+## Offline inference
+
+```python
+from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
+
+llm = LLM(
+    model="Qwen/Qwen3-4B",
+    dtype="bfloat16",
+    enable_prefix_caching=False,
+    speculative_config={
+        "method": "longspark",
+        "model": "Hehy/LongSpark-Qwen3-4B",
+    },
+)
+
+outputs = llm.generate(
+    ["Explain why the night sky is dark."],
+    SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=128),
+)
+print(outputs[0].outputs[0].text)
+```
+
+`method` and `num_speculative_tokens` may be omitted. A checkpoint with
+`model_type="draftfreekv"` and architecture `DraftFreeKVModel` is detected as
+LongSpark, and its `block_size` selects the checkpoint's draft width.
+To use fewer draft tokens, set `num_speculative_tokens` to any integer from
+1 through the checkpoint's `block_size`, inclusive. For example,
+`"num_speculative_tokens": 3` uses the first three proposals from a seven-token
+checkpoint. The trained draft block and checkpoint weights keep their original
+shape; only the requested number of proposals is sampled and verified. Do not
+change the checkpoint's `block_size` to select a runtime draft length.
+
+The following server command uses three speculative tokens:
+
+```bash
+vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-4B \
+    --dtype bfloat16 \
+    --no-enable-prefix-caching \
+    --speculative-config '{
+      "method": "longspark",
+      "model": "Hehy/LongSpark-Qwen3-4B",
+      "num_speculative_tokens": 3
+    }'
+```
+
+## Supported configuration
+
+The initial native integration deliberately fails closed outside the
+checkpoint's validated execution contract:
+
+- CUDA with Model Runner V2 and the `FLASH_ATTN` backend;
+- BF16 Qwen3 target and LongSpark draft weights, with a BF16 target KV cache;
+- a Qwen3 target with a LongSpark checkpoint trained for the same hidden,
+  vocabulary, attention, MLP, layer-count, and RoPE configuration;
+- TP, PP, DCP, PCP, and draft TP all equal to 1;
+- text-only requests, without target LoRA or prefix caching; and
+- `1 <= num_speculative_tokens <= block_size`, where `block_size` comes from
+  the checkpoint; omitting `num_speculative_tokens` uses the full block.
+
+The fused Triton kernels are shape-parameterized. Query/KV head counts, GQA
+ratio, head dimension, global/raw/local window sizes, Markov rank, delta width,
+and runtime batch size come from the checkpoint configuration or input tensor.
+Consequently, the implementation is not tied to Qwen3-4B tensor dimensions;
+another Qwen3 LongSpark pair can use the same path when its checkpoint declares
+matching dimensions. The draft network itself is still Qwen3-style, so this
+does not by itself enable checkpoints trained for unrelated model families.
+
+Target-model CUDA graphs remain available. For greedy, unwatermarked decoding,
+the LongSpark draft backbone and Markov sampler use vLLM's configured CUDA Graph
+capture sizes and pad to the nearest captured batch, just like the target model.
+Batches above the largest configured capture size and sampling modes that need
+draft logits use the parameterized eager draft path. Raw-window rows remain
+transient and are never stored in a second persistent K/V cache. These
+constraints are checked during configuration or startup so unsupported
+combinations do not silently take another speculative path.
+
+For a token-for-token greedy correctness comparison against non-speculative
+decoding, set `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1` for both runs. Without batch-invariant
+kernels, the target's different verification batch shapes can change a greedy
+choice at near-tied logits even though speculative verification remains
+lossless.
+
+Available checkpoint pairs are listed in the
+[LongSpark collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/Hehy/longspark).
+
+The repository [README](../../../README.md#longspark) includes local serving and
+`vllm bench serve` commands, plus LongSpark/DFlash measurements on long-context
+inputs and MT-Bench.

+def _rms_norm_reference(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    normalized = hidden_states.float()
+    if residual is not None:
+        normalized = normalized + residual.float()
+        residual = normalized.to(hidden_states.dtype)
+    variance = normalized.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+    normalized = normalized * torch.rsqrt(variance + eps)
+    output = (normalized.to(weight.dtype) * weight).to(hidden_states.dtype)
+    return output, residual
+

+    eps = 1e-6
+    norm = _LongSparkRMSNorm(hidden_size, eps).to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    norm.weight.data.normal_(generator=generator)
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(

+class _FeedForward(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, in_features: int, hidden_size: int, out_features: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.net = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_size, bias=False),
+            nn.SiLU(),
+            nn.Linear(hidden_size, out_features, bias=False),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.net(hidden_states)
+
+
+class _LongSparkRMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Eager-friendly, shape-parameterized RMSNorm for the draft graph.
+
+    The target model normally lets ``torch.compile`` lower the IR RMSNorm.
+    LongSpark is captured directly by a CUDA graph instead, so the IR-native
+    implementation would otherwise expand every norm into several ATen
+    kernels.  Use vLLM's unquantized CUDA kernel explicitly while retaining a
+    portable native fallback for tests and unsupported layouts.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, eps: float) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size))
+        set_weight_attrs(self.weight, {"dummy_weight_value": 1.0})
+        self.variance_epsilon = eps
+
+    def _can_use_cuda_kernel(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, residual: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> bool:
+        return (
+            hidden_states.is_cuda
+            and hidden_states.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+            and self.weight.dtype == hidden_states.dtype
+            and hidden_states.is_contiguous()
+            and (
+                residual is None
+                or (
+                    residual.dtype == hidden_states.dtype
+                    and residual.device == hidden_states.device
+                    and residual.shape == hidden_states.shape
+                    and residual.is_contiguous()
+                )
+            )
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if self._can_use_cuda_kernel(hidden_states, residual):
+            if residual is None:
+                output = torch.empty_like(hidden_states)
+                ops.rms_norm(
+                    output,
+                    hidden_states,
+                    self.weight.data,
+                    self.variance_epsilon,
+                )
+                return output
+            ops.fused_add_rms_norm(
+                hidden_states,
+                residual,
+                self.weight.data,
+                self.variance_epsilon,
+            )
+            return hidden_states, residual
+
+        original_dtype = hidden_states.dtype
+        normalized = hidden_states.float()
+        if residual is not None:
+            normalized = normalized + residual.float()
+            residual = normalized.to(original_dtype)
+        variance = normalized.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        normalized = normalized * torch.rsqrt(variance + self.variance_epsilon)
+        normalized = (normalized.to(self.weight.dtype) * self.weight).to(original_dtype)
+        if residual is None:
+            return normalized
+        return normalized, residual
+

+class _DraftStateEncoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_layers: int, hidden_size: int, eps: float):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.proj = _FeedForward(num_layers * hidden_size, hidden_size, hidden_size)
+        self.norm = _LongSparkRMSNorm(hidden_size, eps=eps)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.norm(self.proj(hidden_states.flatten(start_dim=1)))

+class _ParallelShiftedInput(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        block_size: int,
+        mask_token_id: int,
+        eps: float,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.block_size = block_size
+        self.mask_token_id = mask_token_id
+        self.position_embedding = nn.Embedding(block_size, hidden_size)
+        self.proj = _FeedForward(2 * hidden_size, hidden_size, hidden_size)
+        self.norm = _LongSparkRMSNorm(hidden_size, eps=eps)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        latest_target_state: torch.Tensor,
+        target_embed_tokens: nn.Module,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch_size = token_ids.shape[0]
+        embedding_weight = getattr(target_embed_tokens, "weight", None)
+        if (
+            isinstance(embedding_weight, torch.Tensor)
+            and token_ids.is_cuda
+            and latest_target_state.is_cuda
+            and latest_target_state.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and embedding_weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and self.position_embedding.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and embedding_weight.device == latest_target_state.device
+            and self.position_embedding.weight.device == latest_target_state.device
+            and embedding_weight.ndim == 2
+            and embedding_weight.shape[1] == latest_target_state.shape[-1]
+            and embedding_weight.stride(1) == 1
+            and self.position_embedding.weight.stride(1) == 1
+        ):
+            shifted_input = prepare_longspark_shifted_input(
+                token_ids,
+                latest_target_state,
+                embedding_weight,
+                self.position_embedding.weight,
+                self.mask_token_id,

+def _rotate_half(hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:

+class _LongSparkMLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, intermediate_size: int):

+        self.up_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, intermediate_size, bias=False)
+        self.gate_up_proj: nn.Linear | None = None
+        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(intermediate_size, hidden_size, bias=False)
+        self.act_fn = SiluAndMul()
+
+    def fuse_weights(self) -> None:
+        if self.gate_up_proj is not None:
+            return
+        gate_up_weight = torch.cat((self.gate_proj.weight, self.up_proj.weight), dim=0)
+        fused = nn.Linear(
+            gate_up_weight.shape[1],
+            gate_up_weight.shape[0],
+            bias=False,
+            device=gate_up_weight.device,
+            dtype=gate_up_weight.dtype,
+        )
+        fused.weight = nn.Parameter(gate_up_weight, requires_grad=False)
+        self.gate_up_proj = fused
+        self.gate_proj = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
+        self.up_proj = None  # type: ignore[assignment]

+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        norm: RMSNorm,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        hidden_states, residual = norm(hidden_states, residual)
+        return self(hidden_states), residual
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.gate_up_proj is None:
+            activated = F.silu(self.gate_proj(hidden_states)) * self.up_proj(
+                hidden_states

+        return self.down_proj(activated)

+    def _validate_runtime_config(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:

+            "tensor_parallel_size": parallel.tensor_parallel_size,
+            "pipeline_parallel_size": parallel.pipeline_parallel_size,
+            "decode_context_parallel_size": parallel.decode_context_parallel_size,
+            "prefill_context_parallel_size": parallel.prefill_context_parallel_size,
+        }

+        if invalid:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "LongSpark MRV2 currently requires TP=PP=DCP=PCP=1; got "
+                + ", ".join(f"{name}={unsupported_parallel[name]}" for name in invalid)
+            )

+            device_type := getattr(self.device, "type", None)
+        ) and device_type != "cuda":
+            raise ValueError("LongSpark MRV2 currently requires CUDA")
+        if self.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+            raise ValueError("LongSpark MRV2 currently requires bfloat16")
+        if vllm_config.model_config.quantization is not None:
+            raise ValueError("LongSpark MRV2 does not support a quantized target")

+                "enable_prefix_caching=False"

+            raise ValueError("LongSpark MRV2 does not yet support target LoRA")
+        if vllm_config.model_config.supports_multimodal_inputs:
+            raise ValueError("LongSpark MRV2 currently supports text-only targets")
+        if not 1 <= self.num_speculative_steps <= int(config.block_size):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "LongSpark requires 1 <= num_speculative_tokens <= checkpoint "
+                f"block_size ({config.block_size}); got {self.num_speculative_steps}"

+    def set_attn(
+        self,
+        model_state: ModelState,
+        kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig,
+        block_tables: BlockTables,
+        target_input_buffers: InputBuffers,
+        target_attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]],
+    ) -> None:
+        # LongSpark has no draft K/V cache or draft attention metadata.  Keep
+        # only the target references needed for paged logical gathers.
+        self.model_state = model_state
+        self.kv_cache_config = kv_cache_config
+        self.block_tables = block_tables
+        self.target_input_buffers = target_input_buffers
+        self.target_attn_groups = target_attn_groups
+
+        target_layers = get_layers_from_vllm_config(
+            self.vllm_config,
+            AttentionLayerBase,  # type: ignore[type-abstract]
+            self._all_target_attn_layer_names,
+        )
+        selected_names: list[str] = []
+        selected_layers: list[AttentionLayerBase] = []
+        for layer_id in self.target_layer_ids:
+            pattern = re.compile(rf"(?:^|\.)layers\.{layer_id}\.self_attn\.attn$")
+            matches = [
+                (name, layer)
+                for name, layer in target_layers.items()
+                if pattern.search(name)
+            ]
+            if len(matches) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "LongSpark expected exactly one target attention layer for "
+                    f"layer {layer_id}, found {[name for name, _ in matches]}"
+                )
+            name, layer = matches[0]
+            backend_name = layer.get_attn_backend().get_name()
+            if backend_name != "FLASH_ATTN":
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "LongSpark MRV2 currently requires FLASH_ATTN target KV "
+                    f"layout, got {backend_name} for {name}"
+                )
+            if (
+                getattr(layer, "num_kv_heads", None) != self.num_kv_heads
+                or getattr(layer, "head_size", None) != self.head_dim
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"LongSpark target KV shape does not match checkpoint at {name}"
+                )
+            selected_names.append(name)
+            selected_layers.append(layer)
+        self.target_attn_layer_names = selected_names
+        self.target_attn_layers = selected_layers
+        group_by_layer = {
+            layer_name: group_id
+            for group_id, group in enumerate(kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups)
+            for layer_name in group.layer_names
+        }
+        try:
+            self.target_block_tables = tuple(
+                block_tables.input_block_tables[group_by_layer[name]]
+                for name in selected_names
+            )

+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"LongSpark target layer has no KV-cache group: {error.args[0]}"
+            ) from error
+        # KV caches are allocated after set_attn() and are rebound once more
+        # between CUDA-graph memory profiling and the real initialization.
+        # Build the device pointer tables lazily from the live tensors.
+        self._target_cache_addresses = ()
+        self._target_block_table_addresses = ()
+        self._target_cache_ptrs = None
+        self._target_block_table_ptrs = None

+    def _target_pointer_tables(self) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        cache_addresses = tuple(
+            layer.kv_cache.data_ptr() for layer in self.target_attn_layers
+        )
+        table_addresses = tuple(table.data_ptr() for table in self.target_block_tables)
+        if (
+            self._target_cache_ptrs is None
+            or cache_addresses != self._target_cache_addresses
+        ):
+            self._target_cache_ptrs = torch.tensor(
+                cache_addresses,
+                dtype=torch.uint64,
+                device=self.device,
+            )
+            self._target_cache_addresses = cache_addresses
+        if (
+            self._target_block_table_ptrs is None
+            or table_addresses != self._target_block_table_addresses
+        ):
+            self._target_block_table_ptrs = torch.tensor(
+                table_addresses,
+                dtype=torch.uint64,
+                device=self.device,

+    @staticmethod
+    def _gather_cache_rows(
+        layer: AttentionLayerBase,
+        block_table_row: torch.Tensor,
+        start: int,
+        end: int,
+        head_dim: int,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        cache = layer.kv_cache
+        if cache.ndim != 4 or cache.shape[-1] != 2 * head_dim:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "LongSpark expected FlashAttention KV cache layout "
+                "[blocks, kv_heads, block_size, 2 * head_dim]"
+            )
+        if cache.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"LongSpark expected BF16 target KV cache, got {cache.dtype}"
+            )
+        block_size = cache.shape[2]
+        positions = torch.arange(start, end, dtype=torch.long, device=cache.device)
+        logical_blocks = torch.div(positions, block_size, rounding_mode="floor")
+        offsets = positions.remainder(block_size)
+        physical_blocks = block_table_row.index_select(0, logical_blocks).long()
+        pages = cache.index_select(0, physical_blocks)
+        row_indices = torch.arange(end - start, device=cache.device)
+        rows = pages.permute(0, 2, 1, 3)[row_indices, offsets]
+        keys, values = rows.split(head_dim, dim=-1)
+        return keys.transpose(0, 1), values.transpose(0, 1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _gather_cache_positions(
+        layer: AttentionLayerBase,
+        block_table_rows: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        head_dim: int,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Gather a dense batch of logical positions without duplicating pages."""
+        cache = layer.kv_cache
+        if cache.ndim != 4 or cache.shape[-1] != 2 * head_dim:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "LongSpark expected FlashAttention KV cache layout "
+                "[blocks, kv_heads, block_size, 2 * head_dim]"
+            )
+        block_size = cache.shape[2]
+        logical_blocks = torch.div(positions, block_size, rounding_mode="floor")
+        offsets = positions.remainder(block_size)
+        physical_blocks = torch.gather(
+            block_table_rows.long(), 1, logical_blocks.long()
+        )
+        rows = cache[physical_blocks, :, offsets]
+        keys, values = rows.split(head_dim, dim=-1)
+        return keys.transpose(1, 2), values.transpose(1, 2)
+
+    def _scan_global_state(
+        self,
+        request_slot: int,
+        batch_index: int,
+        start: int,
+        end: int,
+        attn_metadata: dict[str, Any],
+    ) -> None:
+        if start >= end:
+            return
+        for layer_index, (name, layer) in enumerate(
+            zip(self.target_attn_layer_names, self.target_attn_layers)
+        ):
+            metadata = attn_metadata[name]
+            block_table_row = metadata.block_table[batch_index]
+            output = lse = None
+            if start > 0:
+                output = self.global_output[request_slot, layer_index]
+                lse = self.global_lse[request_slot, layer_index]
+            query = self.model.global_queries[layer_index]
+            for chunk_start in range(start, end, self._global_scan_chunk_size):
+                chunk_end = min(chunk_start + self._global_scan_chunk_size, end)
+                keys, values = self._gather_cache_rows(
+                    layer,
+                    block_table_row,
+                    chunk_start,
+                    chunk_end,
+                    self.head_dim,
+                )
+                chunk_output, chunk_lse = normalized_gqa_attention(query, keys, values)
+                if output is None:
+                    output, lse = chunk_output, chunk_lse
+                else:
+                    assert lse is not None
+                    output, lse = merge_normalized_attention(
+                        output, lse, chunk_output, chunk_lse
+                    )
+            assert output is not None and lse is not None
+            self.global_output[request_slot, layer_index].copy_(output)
+            self.global_lse[request_slot, layer_index].copy_(lse)
+
+    def _update_global_states(
+        self,
+        input_batch: InputBatch,
+        committed_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_metadata: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        defer_decode: bool = False,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        rebuild_rows: list[tuple[int, int, int]] = []
+        prefill_delta_rows: list[tuple[int, int, int, int]] = []
+        decode_batch_indices: list[int] = []
+        decode_request_slots: list[int] = []
+        for batch_index, request_id in enumerate(input_batch.req_ids):
+            request_slot = int(input_batch.idx_mapping_np[batch_index])
+            rebuild = self._state_owner[request_slot] != request_id
+            if rebuild:
+                # A new request has no prior speculative tokens, so the CPU
+                # upper bound is exact.  Full scans are intentionally a host-
+                # planned, infrequent prefill operation.
+                end = int(input_batch.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound[batch_index])
+                rebuild_rows.append((batch_index, request_slot, end))
+                self._state_committed_len[request_slot] = end
+                self.num_full_scans += 1
+            elif input_batch.is_prefilling_np[batch_index]:
+                # Chunked prefill can add more rows than the fixed-size decode
+                # delta kernel supports.  Prefill lengths are host-known and
+                # exact because no draft tokens are being verified.
+                start = int(self._state_committed_len[request_slot])
+                end = int(input_batch.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound[batch_index])
+                if start < end:
+                    prefill_delta_rows.append((batch_index, request_slot, start, end))
+                    self.num_delta_updates += 1
+                    self.num_delta_rows += end - start
+                self._state_committed_len[request_slot] = end
+            else:
+                decode_batch_indices.append(batch_index)
+                decode_request_slots.append(request_slot)
+                self.num_delta_updates += 1
+            self._state_owner[request_slot] = request_id
+
+        if rebuild_rows:
+            self._scan_global_batch(rebuild_rows, attn_metadata)
+        if prefill_delta_rows:
+            self._update_global_delta_batch(prefill_delta_rows, attn_metadata)
+        deferred_update = None
+        if decode_batch_indices:
+            if len(decode_batch_indices) == input_batch.num_reqs:
+                batch_indices = self._batch_indices[: input_batch.num_reqs]
+                request_slots = input_batch.idx_mapping[: input_batch.num_reqs]
+            else:
+                batch_indices = torch.tensor(
+                    decode_batch_indices, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+                )
+                request_slots = torch.tensor(
+                    decode_request_slots, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+                )
+            if defer_decode and len(decode_batch_indices) == input_batch.num_reqs:
+                deferred_update = request_slots
+            else:
+                starts = self._state_committed_lens_gpu.index_select(0, request_slots)
+                ends = committed_lens.index_select(0, batch_indices)
+                self._update_global_decode_batch(
+                    batch_indices, request_slots, starts, ends, attn_metadata
+                )
+
+        # Publish the exact, rejection-adjusted lengths for the next decode
+        # step without making the target stream wait on a D2H transfer. Steady
+        # CUDA-graph decode folds this publish into graph input preparation,
+        # avoiding two index-selects plus a separate index-copy launch.
+        if deferred_update is None:
+            self._state_committed_lens_gpu.index_copy_(
+                0,
+                input_batch.idx_mapping[: input_batch.num_reqs],
+                committed_lens,
+            )
+        return deferred_update
+
+    def _scan_global_batch(
+        self,
+        rows: list[tuple[int, int, int]],
+        attn_metadata: dict[str, Any],
+    ) -> None:
+        batch_indices = torch.tensor(
+            [row[0] for row in rows], dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+        )
+        request_slots = torch.tensor(
+            [row[1] for row in rows], dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+        )
+        ends = torch.tensor(
+            [row[2] for row in rows], dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+        )
+        max_end = max(row[2] for row in rows)
+        for chunk_start in range(0, max_end, self._global_scan_chunk_size):
+            active = ends > chunk_start
+            active_indices = active.nonzero().flatten()
+            active_batch = batch_indices.index_select(0, active_indices)
+            active_slots = request_slots.index_select(0, active_indices)
+            active_ends = ends.index_select(0, active_indices)
+            width = min(self._global_scan_chunk_size, max_end - chunk_start)
+            positions = (
+                chunk_start
+                + torch.arange(width, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device)[None]
+            )
+            positions = positions.expand(active_indices.numel(), -1)
+            valid_mask = positions < active_ends[:, None]
+            safe_positions = torch.minimum(positions, active_ends[:, None] - 1)
+            for layer_index, (name, layer) in enumerate(
+                zip(self.target_attn_layer_names, self.target_attn_layers)
+            ):
+                block_tables = attn_metadata[name].block_table.index_select(
+                    0, active_batch
+                )
+                keys, values = self._gather_cache_positions(
+                    layer, block_tables, safe_positions, self.head_dim
+                )
+                output, lse = normalized_gqa_attention_batched(
+                    self.model.global_queries[layer_index],
+                    keys,
+                    values,
+                    valid_mask,
+                )
+                if chunk_start:
+                    output, lse = merge_normalized_attention(
+                        self.global_output[active_slots, layer_index],
+                        self.global_lse[active_slots, layer_index],
+                        output,
+                        lse,
+                    )
+                self.global_output[:, layer_index].index_copy_(0, active_slots, output)
+                self.global_lse[:, layer_index].index_copy_(0, active_slots, lse)
+
+    def _update_global_delta_batch(
+        self,
+        rows: list[tuple[int, int, int, int]],
+        attn_metadata: dict[str, Any],
+    ) -> None:
+        batch_indices = torch.tensor(
+            [row[0] for row in rows], dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+        )
+        request_slots = torch.tensor(
+            [row[1] for row in rows], dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+        )
+        starts = torch.tensor(
+            [row[2] for row in rows], dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+        )
+        ends = torch.tensor(
+            [row[3] for row in rows], dtype=torch.long, device=self.device
+        )
+        width = max(row[3] - row[2] for row in rows)
+        use_kernel = width <= self.max_accepted_tokens
+        if not use_kernel:
+            positions = (
+                starts[:, None]
+                + torch.arange(width, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device)[None]
+            )
+            valid_mask = positions < ends[:, None]
+            safe_positions = torch.minimum(positions, ends[:, None] - 1)
+        for layer_index, (name, layer) in enumerate(
+            zip(self.target_attn_layer_names, self.target_attn_layers)
+        ):
+            if use_kernel:
+                update_longspark_global_delta(
+                    query=self.model.global_queries[layer_index],
+                    cache=layer.kv_cache,
+                    block_table=attn_metadata[name].block_table,
+                    batch_indices=batch_indices,
+                    request_slots=request_slots,
+                    starts=starts,
+                    ends=ends,
+                    state_output=self.global_output[:, layer_index],
+                    state_lse=self.global_lse[:, layer_index],
+                    max_delta_rows=width,
+                )
+            else:
+                block_tables = attn_metadata[name].block_table.index_select(
+                    0, batch_indices
+                )
+                keys, values = self._gather_cache_positions(
+                    layer, block_tables, safe_positions, self.head_dim
+                )
+                delta_output, delta_lse = normalized_gqa_attention_batched(
+                    self.model.global_queries[layer_index],
+                    keys,
+                    values,
+                    valid_mask,
+                )
+                output, lse = merge_normalized_attention(
+                    self.global_output[request_slots, layer_index],
+                    self.global_lse[request_slots, layer_index],
+                    delta_output,
+                    delta_lse,
+                )
+                self.global_output[:, layer_index].index_copy_(0, request_slots, output)
+                self.global_lse[:, layer_index].index_copy_(0, request_slots, lse)
+
+    def _update_global_decode_batch(
+        self,
+        batch_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        request_slots: torch.Tensor,
+        starts: torch.Tensor,
+        ends: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_metadata: dict[str, Any],
+    ) -> None:
+        """Update global memory for a decode step without host synchronization."""
+        for layer_index, (name, layer) in enumerate(
+            zip(self.target_attn_layer_names, self.target_attn_layers)
+        ):
+            update_longspark_global_delta(
+                query=self.model.global_queries[layer_index],
+                cache=layer.kv_cache,
+                block_table=attn_metadata[name].block_table,

+"""Online-softmax primitives for LongSpark global-memory request state."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def normalized_gqa_attention_batched(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    keys: torch.Tensor,
+    values: torch.Tensor,
+    valid_mask: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Batched normalized GQA output for a shared query bank.
+
+    Shapes are ``query=[Hq, Q, D]``, ``keys/values=[B, Hkv, K, D]``, and
+    ``valid_mask=[B, K]``. Every batch row must contain at least one valid key.
+    """
+    if query.ndim != 3 or keys.ndim != 4 or values.shape != keys.shape:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "LongSpark batched Global16 expects rank-3 query and rank-4 K/V"
+        )
+    batch_size, kv_heads, key_rows, key_dim = keys.shape
+    query_heads, query_rows, head_dim = query.shape
+    if valid_mask.shape != (batch_size, key_rows) or valid_mask.dtype != torch.bool:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark batched Global16 mask shape does not align")
+    if not torch.all(valid_mask.any(dim=-1)):
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark batched Global16 requires a key per request")
+    if key_dim != head_dim or query_heads % kv_heads:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark Global16 query and target KV heads do not align")
+
+    query_for_scores = query if query.dtype == keys.dtype else query.to(keys.dtype)
+    groups = query_heads // kv_heads
+    grouped_query = query_for_scores.reshape(kv_heads, groups, query_rows, head_dim)
+    scores = torch.einsum("hgqd,bhkd->bhgqk", grouped_query, keys).reshape(
+        batch_size, query_heads, query_rows, key_rows
+    )
+    scores = scores.float().mul_(head_dim**-0.5)
+    scores.masked_fill_(~valid_mask[:, None, None], -torch.inf)
+    max_logits = scores.max(dim=-1).values
+    weights = torch.exp(scores - max_logits[..., None])
+    normalizer = weights.sum(dim=-1)
+    grouped_weights = weights.to(values.dtype).reshape(
+        batch_size, kv_heads, groups, query_rows, key_rows
+    )
+    weighted_values = torch.einsum(
+        "bhgqk,bhkd->bhgqd", grouped_weights, values
+    ).reshape(batch_size, query_heads, query_rows, head_dim)
+    output = weighted_values.float() / normalizer[..., None]
+    logsumexp = max_logits + normalizer.log()
+    return output, logsumexp
+
+
+def normalized_gqa_attention(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    keys: torch.Tensor,
+    values: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return normalized GQA output and logsumexp.
+
+    Shapes are ``query=[Hq, Q, D]`` and ``keys/values=[Hkv, K, D]``.
+    Score and accumulator arithmetic follows the LongSpark reference: QK is
+    evaluated in the cache dtype and promoted to FP32 before softmax; values
+    are accumulated into FP32.
+    """
+    if query.ndim != 3 or keys.ndim != 3 or values.shape != keys.shape:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark Global16 expects rank-3 query/K/V tensors")
+    query_heads, query_rows, head_dim = query.shape
+    kv_heads, key_rows, key_dim = keys.shape
+    if key_rows == 0:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark Global16 requires at least one target KV row")
+    if key_dim != head_dim or query_heads % kv_heads:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark Global16 query and target KV heads do not align")
+
+    query_for_scores = query if query.dtype == keys.dtype else query.to(keys.dtype)
+    groups = query_heads // kv_heads
+    grouped_query = query_for_scores.reshape(kv_heads, groups, query_rows, head_dim)
+    scores = torch.einsum("hgqd,hkd->hgqk", grouped_query, keys).reshape(
+        query_heads, query_rows, key_rows
+    )
+    scores = scores.float().mul_(head_dim**-0.5)
+    max_logits = scores.max(dim=-1).values
+    weights = torch.exp(scores - max_logits[..., None])
+    normalizer = weights.sum(dim=-1)
+    grouped_weights = weights.to(values.dtype).reshape(
+        kv_heads, groups, query_rows, key_rows
+    )
+    weighted_values = torch.einsum("hgqk,hkd->hgqd", grouped_weights, values).reshape(
+        query_heads, query_rows, head_dim
+    )
+    output = weighted_values.float() / normalizer[..., None]
+    logsumexp = max_logits + normalizer.log()
+    return output, logsumexp
+
+
+def merge_normalized_attention(
+    first_output: torch.Tensor,
+    first_lse: torch.Tensor,
+    second_output: torch.Tensor,
+    second_lse: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Merge two normalized attention results without rereading old K/V."""
+    if first_output.shape != second_output.shape:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark Global16 outputs must have matching shapes")
+    if first_lse.shape != second_lse.shape:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark Global16 logsumexp tensors must match")
+    if first_output.shape[:-1] != first_lse.shape:
+        raise ValueError("LongSpark Global16 output and logsumexp do not align")
+
+    merged_lse = torch.logaddexp(first_lse.float(), second_lse.float())
+    first_weight = torch.exp(first_lse.float() - merged_lse)
+    second_weight = torch.exp(second_lse.float() - merged_lse)
+    output = (
+        first_output.float() * first_weight[..., None]
+        + second_output.float() * second_weight[..., None]
+    )
+    return output, merged_lse

+        draft_vllm_config = replace(draft_vllm_config, load_config=draft_load_config)
+
+    with set_model_tag("longspark_head"):
+        draft_model = get_model(
+            vllm_config=draft_vllm_config,
+            model_config=draft_model_config,
+        )
+    draft_model.optimize_for_inference()
+
+    target_language_model = (
+        target_model.get_language_model()
+        if hasattr(target_model, "get_language_model")
+        else target_model
+    )
+    target_inner = target_language_model.model
+    target_embed = getattr(target_inner, "embed_tokens", None)
+    target_norm = getattr(target_inner, "norm", None)
+    target_lm_head = get_target_lm_head(target_model, target_language_model)
+    target_logits_processor = getattr(target_model, "logits_processor", None)
+    if any(
+        module is None
+        for module in (
+            target_embed,
+            target_norm,
+            target_lm_head,
+            target_logits_processor,
+        )
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "LongSpark requires target embedding, final norm, lm_head, and "
+            "logits processor modules"
+        )
+    draft_model.set_target_modules(
+        target_embed,
+        target_norm,
+        target_lm_head,
+        target_logits_processor,
+    )
+    return draft_model
